text:
The largest recorded tree-cover loss event on this property was in 2020, at about 67.7 ha (Hansen GFC data). Earlier events were 25.5 ha in 2015, 4.8 ha in 2017 and 0.8 ha in 2008.

All of these happened before the 2020-12-31 baseline, so they are history rather than part of the 2021–2025 claim. For that period, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected, with full valid data coverage. The only post-baseline loss was about 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches under the 0.5 ha threshold, so it is not counted as an event.

Limits: changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. This is not a compliance finding, and it says nothing about anything outside the evaluated period.
